platformScope: Windows x64 / GDScript / local stdio and loopback HTTP only; remote production disabled

defectReplay.D08: PASS: project-relative and res:// scene paths return the same real scene
defectReplay.D11: PASS: direct-file and MCP authorization tests reject traversal, Windows junction, symlink, hard link writes, protected paths and outside targets
defectReplay.remaining: D07 and D09 remain EXPECTED_DEFECT for later tasks

contractsVerified: Project-relative, res:// and approved contained absolute paths use one resolver in scene, project-file, script, static scene-tree, search, exact-edit and repair entrypoints
uid:// reads resolve only through actual Godot .gd.uid or text-resource header mapping, with unique match and bounded scan; UID writes fail closed
Existing files and each parent are checked for canonical location, Windows casing, symlink/junction and containment; new targets require an existing parent
Windows ADS, UNC, drive-relative spelling, traversal, empty segments and trailing dot/space are rejected; hard-linked project files cannot be overwritten
Generic read/write access to .git, .godot and .harness is denied; evidence output remains under a separate authorization policy
Remote HTTP bind is disabled in both environment parsing and direct server startup, including when MCP_HTTP_ALLOW_REMOTE=true
Real Windows junction rejection ran without skip; full and Godot smoke suites ran without skips
limitations: Path validation and subsequent readFile/writeFile calls are not atomic against a malicious local process changing parent directories. This is not an OS filesystem sandbox; local trusted-project scope only
UID mapping currently covers .gd.uid and .tscn/.tres text headers; missing or ambiguous IDs fail closed, binary imported-resource UIDs are not declared supported
One interim full-suite run failed because a roadmap test assumed G1 was still pending; the test now selects a pending Gate and the final same-source full suite passes
G2 requires T10-T15 and is not run; T09 completion does not qualify remote service or production release
Raw runs are Git-ignored and must be rerun if unavailable after migration
